Verify with UMS Bursar/CIGE. requirements.previous_education: SPM with at least 5 credits including Bahasa Melayu and passed History. Minimum Grade B+ in Mathematics and Grade C+ in 3 of Physics/Chemistry/Biology. Grade C in Additional Mathematics. Bumiputera only.
